effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon would digivolve into a green card with the [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]), by suspending this Tamer, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] You may unsuspend 1 of your Digimon with [Angoramon] in its text.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
